from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEpsRecord(BaseModel):
    """Per-share financial data extracted from a single company's filing."""
    registrant_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The label used for the metric in the document, e.g. 'Basic net income per common share'")
    earnings_per_share_value: float | None = Field(description="The reported Basic Earnings Per Share value")
    quote_context: str | None = Field(description="Short text snippet containing the value for context")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    eps_records: list[CompanyEpsRecord]
